description: Import everything AppsFlyer holds for this app: installs and the channel, campaign, adset and ad behind each one, in-app events and purchases, uninstalls, reinstalls, ad revenue and retargeting traffic. All twelve raw-data reports are walked; ones the AppsFlyer plan lacks are skipped, not failed. Runs in the background and keeps going after this call. mode 'auto' (default) only pulls the days since the last finished import when there is one, and walks the full history otherwise. 'full' re-walks everything. resume=true continues a failed or cancelled run from where it stopped. Safe to call while a run is going: it reports that run instead of starting another. Anything already imported is counted once. Check progress with get_appsflyer_import_status.

resume.description: Continue the last failed or cancelled run

name: start_appsflyer_import
title: Start the AppsFlyer import
